B0001.detail: Airbag circuit fault — airbags may not deploy as designed.
B0001.title: Driver frontal stage 1 deploy control

B0083.detail: Occupant classification system fault — the passenger airbag may be suppressed.
B0083.title: Passenger seat weight sensor fault

C0035.detail: The ABS module cannot read the left-front wheel speed.
C0035.title: Left front wheel speed sensor circuit

P0010.detail: The intake camshaft oil control solenoid circuit is out of range.
P0010.title: Camshaft actuator circuit fault, bank 1

causes: Sludge blocking the phaser oil passages
P0011.detail: The ECU commanded a cam angle that the engine could not achieve — often called cam phaser rattle.
P0011.title: Camshaft timing over-advanced, bank 1

P0014.detail: Exhaust camshaft timing is outside the commanded range.
P0014.title: Camshaft timing over-advanced, bank 1 exhaust

P0016.detail: The relationship between the crank and cam sensors is wrong — a mechanical timing problem, not a sensor fault.
P0016.title: Crankshaft / camshaft position correlation, bank 1

P0017.detail: Mechanical timing relationship is incorrect on the exhaust camshaft.
P0017.title: Crankshaft / camshaft correlation, bank 1 sensor B

P0030.detail: The heater circuit for the upstream oxygen sensor is not drawing the expected current.
P0030.title: O₂ heater control circuit, bank 1 sensor 1

P0031.detail: Heater circuit resistance is too low — usually the sensor element.
P0031.title: O₂ heater circuit low, bank 1 sensor 1

P0032.detail: Heater circuit is open or drawing too little current.
P0032.title: O₂ heater circuit high, bank 1 sensor 1

P0036.detail: Downstream oxygen sensor heater circuit fault.
P0036.title: O₂ heater control circuit, bank 1 sensor 2

P0051.detail: Upstream oxygen sensor heater circuit fault on bank 2.
P0051.title: O₂ heater circuit, bank 2 sensor 1

P0101.detail: The MAF sensor signal does not match what the ECU expects for the operating conditions.
P0101.title: Mass air flow circuit range/performance

P0102.detail: Measured airflow is lower than physically plausible.
P0102.title: Mass air flow circuit low input

P0103.detail: Measured airflow is higher than physically plausible.
P0103.title: Mass air flow circuit high input

P0106.detail: MAP sensor reading does not track expected manifold pressure.
P0106.title: Manifold absolute pressure circuit range/performance

P0107.detail: Manifold pressure signal is below normal range.
P0107.title: MAP circuit low input

P0108.detail: Manifold pressure signal is above normal range.
P0108.title: MAP circuit high input

P0113.detail: IAT sensor reports an unrealistically cold intake charge — usually an open circuit.
P0113.title: Intake air temperature circuit high input

P0117.detail: Coolant temperature signal is unrealistically high.
P0117.title: Engine coolant temperature circuit low input

causes: Trapped air in the cooling system
P0118.detail: Coolant temperature signal is unrealistically cold — usually an open circuit.
P0118.title: Engine coolant temperature circuit high input

causes: Carbon buildup in the throttle body
P0120.detail: The ECU cannot trust the throttle position signal.
P0120.title: Throttle position sensor circuit fault

P0125.detail: The engine never reached the temperature needed for fuel control — a stuck-open thermostat is the usual cause.
P0125.title: Insufficient coolant temperature for closed loop

P0128.detail: The engine warms up too slowly — thermostat is stuck open.
P0128.title: Coolant thermostat below regulating temperature

P0130.detail: Upstream oxygen sensor signal is out of range.
P0130.title: O₂ sensor circuit, bank 1 sensor 1

causes: Lean condition (vacuum leak, low fuel pressure)
P0131.title: O₂ sensor circuit low voltage, bank 1 sensor 1

causes: Contamination from coolant or oil burning
P0133.detail: Upstream oxygen sensor is responding too slowly for closed-loop control.
P0133.title: O₂ sensor slow response, bank 1 sensor 1

P0134.detail: Upstream sensor signal is not changing at all.
P0134.title: O₂ sensor circuit no activity, bank 1 sensor 1

P0135.detail: Upstream oxygen sensor heater has failed.
P0135.title: O₂ heater circuit, bank 1 sensor 1

P0137.detail: Downstream oxygen sensor is stuck lean.
P0137.title: O₂ sensor circuit low voltage, bank 1 sensor 2

P0138.detail: Downstream oxygen sensor is stuck rich.
P0138.title: O₂ sensor circuit high voltage, bank 1 sensor 2

P0151.title: O₂ sensor circuit low voltage, bank 2 sensor 1

P0153.detail: Bank 2 upstream sensor responds too slowly.
P0153.title: O₂ sensor slow response, bank 2 sensor 1

causes: Weak fuel pump or clogged filter
P0171.detail: The ECU added maximum fuel and still could not reach the target air/fuel ratio. A vacuum leak is the most common cause.
P0171.title: System too lean, bank 1

P0172.detail: Fuel delivery is higher than the ECU commands.
P0172.title: System too rich, bank 1

P0174.detail: Bank 2 is running lean — often a shared intake leak if bank 1 is also affected.
P0174.title: System too lean, bank 2

P0200.detail: One or more fuel injector circuits is not operating correctly.
P0200.title: Injector circuit fault

P0201.detail: Cylinder 1 injector circuit is out of range.
P0201.title: Injector circuit fault, cylinder 1

P0217.detail: The engine exceeded its safe operating temperature.
P0217.title: Engine over-temperature condition

P0230.detail: The fuel pump relay or driver circuit is not operating correctly.
P0230.title: Fuel pump primary circuit fault

P0299.detail: Boost pressure is lower than commanded.
P0299.title: Turbo underboost

P0300.detail: Misfires detected across more than one cylinder — the engine can damage the catalytic converter if driven hard.
P0300.title: Random / multiple cylinder misfire

causes: Coolant or oil leaking into a cylinder
P0316.detail: Misfires occur in the first 1000 revolutions after start.
P0316.title: Misfire detected at start-up

P0325.detail: The knock sensor signal is missing or out of range.
P0325.title: Knock sensor circuit fault, bank 1

P0335.detail: The ECU has lost the crankshaft signal — the engine may stall or not start.
P0335.title: Crankshaft position sensor circuit fault

P0340.detail: The ECU cannot read the intake camshaft position.
P0340.title: Camshaft position sensor circuit fault, bank 1

P0345.detail: Bank 2 camshaft position signal is missing.
P0345.title: Camshaft position sensor circuit fault, bank 2

P0351.detail: The ECU cannot drive ignition coil A.
P0351.title: Ignition coil A primary/secondary circuit

P0401.detail: Commanded EGR flow is not being detected.
P0401.title: EGR flow insufficient

P0403.detail: The EGR valve control circuit is not operating correctly.
P0403.title: EGR control circuit fault

P0411.detail: Air injection system is not delivering the expected flow.
P0411.title: Secondary air injection incorrect flow

causes: Engine misfire or rich running damaging the cat
P0420.detail: The downstream O₂ sensor follows the upstream one too closely, meaning the converter is not storing oxygen as it should.
P0420.title: Catalyst efficiency below threshold, bank 1

P0430.detail: Bank 2 converter is below efficiency threshold.
P0430.title: Catalyst efficiency below threshold, bank 2

P0440.detail: The EVAP system failed its self-test.
P0440.title: Evaporative emission system fault

P0442.detail: A small leak was detected in the EVAP system.
P0442.title: Evaporative emission system small leak

P0455.detail: A large leak — often simply a loose fuel cap — was detected.
P0455.title: Evaporative emission system large leak

P0456.detail: A very small EVAP leak was detected.
P0456.title: Evaporative emission system very small leak

causes: Reseat or replace the fuel cap
Clear the code and re-check after two drive cycles
P0457.detail: The system detected the fuel cap is not sealing.
P0457.title: EVAP system leak detected (fuel cap loose/off)

causes: ABS module issue feeding the signal
P0500.detail: The ECU is not receiving a valid vehicle speed signal.
P0500.title: Vehicle speed sensor fault

P0505.detail: The engine cannot maintain target idle speed.
P0505.title: Idle control system fault

P0506.detail: Idle RPM is below the target range.
P0506.title: Idle speed lower than expected

P0507.detail: Idle RPM is above the target range.
P0507.title: Idle speed higher than expected

P0521.detail: Oil pressure signal is inconsistent with engine operation.
P0521.title: Engine oil pressure sensor range/performance

P0562.detail: Charging system voltage is below the normal range while running.
P0562.title: System voltage low

P0563.detail: Charging voltage is above the safe range.
P0563.title: System voltage high

P0571.detail: The ECU cannot confirm brake pedal position — cruise control may be disabled.
P0571.title: Brake switch circuit fault

P0601.detail: The ECU's internal memory failed a self-check.
P0601.title: Internal control module memory checksum error

P0606.detail: The powertrain control module reported an internal processor fault.
P0606.title: PCM processor fault

P0620.detail: The PCM cannot control charging as expected.
P0620.title: Generator control circuit fault

P0700.detail: The transmission control module is reporting a fault — this is an informational code pointing to the TCM.
P0700.title: Transmission control system fault

P0705.detail: Gear selector position cannot be determined reliably.
P0705.title: Transmission range sensor circuit fault

P0715.detail: The transmission cannot read input shaft speed.
P0715.title: Input/turbine speed sensor circuit fault

P0730.detail: Measured input/output speed ratio does not match the commanded gear — slipping or solenoid fault.
P0730.title: Incorrect gear ratio

P0740.detail: The TCC solenoid circuit is not operating correctly.
P0740.title: Torque converter clutch circuit fault

P0741.detail: The TCC is not engaging when commanded — fuel economy and heat suffer.
P0741.title: Torque converter clutch stuck off

P0780.detail: The transmission could not complete a commanded shift.
P0780.title: Shift error detected

P1000.detail: The ECU has not finished its self-tests since the codes were cleared.
P1000.title: OBD readiness test not complete

P1133.title: O₂ sensor insufficient switching, bank 1 sensor 1

P1345.detail: Timing relationship between camshaft and crankshaft is out of spec.
P1345.title: Cam/crank correlation fault (manufacturer-specific)

P1450.detail: Manufacturer-specific EVAP fault — commonly a stuck purge or vent valve.
P1450.title: EVAP system unable to bleed vacuum

P2002.detail: DPF is not trapping soot as expected.
P2002.title: Diesel particulate filter efficiency below threshold

P2101.detail: The electronic throttle did not reach the commanded position.
P2101.title: Throttle actuator control range/performance

P2135.detail: The two throttle position signals do not match.
P2135.title: Throttle position sensors disagree

P2181.detail: The engine is not maintaining expected coolant temperature under load.
P2181.title: Cooling system performance

P2463.detail: The DPF is loaded with soot and needs regeneration.
P2463.title: Diesel particulate filter soot accumulation

U0100.detail: Other modules cannot see the engine control module on the network.
U0100.title: Lost communication with ECM/PCM

U0101.detail: The transmission control module dropped off the network.
U0101.title: Lost communication with TCM

U0121.detail: The ABS module is not responding on the network.
U0121.title: Lost communication with ABS module

U0140.detail: The BCM stopped responding on the network.
U0140.title: Lost communication with body control module

U0155.detail: The cluster dropped off the network.
U0155.title: Lost communication with instrument cluster
